name: PCSX2

biosRequirements.label: PlayStation 2 BIOS
biosRequirements.note: Dump the BIOS from your own PlayStation 2. Typical files are 4 MB (e.g. SCPH-70012.bin).

notes: OmniDeck launches PCSX2 with -nogui (batch mode) so closing the game returns to OmniDeck.
All PCSX2 data is kept outside the program folder via -datapath, so updates and rollbacks never touch settings or saves.
assumptions: Verified against PCSX2 v2.8.2 source (pcsx2-qt/QtHost.cpp): -batch, -nogui, -fullscreen, -datapath, -logfile and -testconfig exist in the stable release.
-gamecfg (per-game INI override) only exists in v2.9 nightlies; on older builds OmniDeck applies per-game overrides by writing them into the base config for the session and restoring it afterwards.
With -datapath <dir>, PCSX2 stores data in <dir>/PCSX2 (Pcsx2Config.cpp EmuFolders::SetDataDirectory).

Settings keys: [Folders] Bios/MemoryCards/Savestates/Snapshots/Cache, [EmuCore/GS] Renderer (int enum), upscale_multiplier, AspectRatio (string), VsyncEnable; [UI] SetupWizardIncomplete, ConfirmShutdown, StartFullscreen; [AutoUpdater] CheckAtStartup; [Logging] EnableFileLogging.
SDL bindings use the form SDL-<n>/<FaceSouth|LeftShoulder|+LeftTrigger|-LeftY...>; hotkey chords join bindings with ' & '.
